why: No major reviewer or authority answers the question; the only authority is the Nextcloud Docker repo, which is about software. The pages that do answer it are an affiliate listicle on a recycled domain with unverifiable testing claims and two regional (Canada, Australia) spec-and-price roundups; the rest answer the neighbouring Docker/home-server question. A focused page comparing Docker-capable x86 NAS units on Nextcloud AIO fit, with current US prices and a direct pick, would stand out.
